title: GST rates on services: union territory tax (UTGST)
description: The rates of union territory tax on intra-State supplies of services in the Table of Notification No. 11/2017-Union Territory Tax (Rate), in force from 1 July 2017, with every amendment since, for serial number 17, item (ii), serial number 21, items (i), (ia) and (ii), and serial number 38: each entry with the heading that column (2) names, the description of column (3), the rate of column (4) and the condition of column (5), where a dash means none. The Table names headings of the Scheme of Classification of Services, never six-digit codes; the notification's Explanations are not included.

instruments: Notification No. 11/2017-Union Territory Tax (Rate), 28 June 2017, G.S.R. 702(E), in force 1 July 2017

Corrigendum of 30 June 2017 to Notification No. 11/2017-Union Territory Tax (Rate), reading its scheme of classification of services as the scheme annexed to Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), G.S.R. 690(E)
Notification No. 27/2018-Union Territory Tax (Rate), 31 December 2018, in force 1 January 2019
Notification No. 20/2019-Union Territory Tax (Rate), 30 September 2019, G.S.R. 732(E), in force 1 October 2019
Notification No. 6/2021-Union Territory Tax (Rate), 30 September 2021, G.S.R. 691(E), in force 1 October 2021
Notification No. 15/2025-Union Territory Tax (Rate), 17 September 2025, G.S.R. 665(E), in force 22 September 2025
